## Automated Tests Required

### 4-1 vp-dynamics 001 — Grip Stack & CarState Contract

**Type**: Logic, with Integration boundary coverage
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`

**Formula source**: Vehicle Physics GDD, `effective_grip = clamp(grip_base × surface_grip_multiplier × tire_runtime_grip_multiplier, 0.20, 1.20)`. Stability must not affect this result.

**What to test**:

- Floor, ceiling, intermediate, zero-multiplier, and exact-boundary grip values.
- Stability changes do not change effective grip.
- CarState contains the specified fields and enum values.
- One immutable CarState is published per tick.
- Injected inputs reach all five states: Driving, OffTrack, WallHit, Pitting, GridLocked.
- Injected off-track multiplier applies on the next tick.
- Surface recovery restores the surface contribution while preserving the tire multiplier.
- Tire multiplier `0.20` produces effective grip `0.20`.
- Player `0.60` and AI `0.40` surface multipliers are consumed unchanged.
- Car-stat and difficulty inputs are not mutated.

**Edge cases**:

- Zero velocity.
- Every State and SlipState value.
- Pit-phase boundaries.
- Simultaneous surface, wall, pit, and grid-lock triggers.
- Repeated events.
- Reused immutable input across ticks.

**Estimated test count**: ~8 parameterized test groups.

### 4-2 vp-dynamics 002 — Vehicle Driver Seam

**Type**: Integration, with Logic/source-guard coverage
**Test file paths**:

- `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`
- `Assets/tests/integration/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`

**Formula source**: No story-specific GDD formula. Tests derive from the ADR seam and explicit acceptance criteria.

**What to test**:

- `IVehicleDriver` exposes only `VehicleHandle`, `VehicleSimState`, and `CarState`.
- Fake-driver execution works without Unity types in the interface.
- `RigidbodyVehicleDriver` maps CarId to the correct Rigidbody.
- `ReadCarState` and `ReadSimStateForNextTick` return the expected adapter data.
- All racing bodies use `Rigidbody.interpolation = None`.
- Player uses `ContinuousDynamic`; AI uses `Continuous`.
- Configured profiling fallback can select `Discrete` without per-tick policy logic.
- Static scan rejects `FixedUpdate()`, `Time.fixedDeltaTime`, and `Time.deltaTime` in `VehiclePhysicsSystem`.
- Static scan rejects obsolete `velocity`, `drag`, and `angularDrag` usage.

**Edge cases**:

- Unknown vehicle handle.
- Multiple car IDs.
- Empty or partial Rigidbody arrays.
- Fallback configuration under profiler pressure.
- Source scan false positives limited to the target system.

**Estimated test count**: ~10 tests.

### 4-3 vp-dynamics 003 — Longitudinal Movement & Step-6 Integration

**Type**: Integration + Logic
**Test file paths**:

- `Assets/tests/integration/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`
- `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`

**Formula source**: Vehicle Physics GDD movement acceptance criteria and acceleration model; this story's baseline movement thresholds are tested as specified.

**What to test**:

- Step 6 force application occurs before the single `Physics.Simulate`.
- CarState readout occurs after simulation.
- Full throttle reaches at least 80% of supplied top speed within 3 simulated seconds.
- Full braking reduces speed to at most 30% of top speed within 3 seconds and tolerance.
- Coasting decays speed toward zero.
- Velocity never becomes negative.
- Brake does not reverse the car.
- GridLocked consumes inputs without changing position, rotation, or velocity.
- `ForceMode.Force` is used for force-valued commands.
- Mass-scaled force is not passed through `Acceleration` or `Impulse`.
- `perfectStartDriveForceMultiplier = 1.15` is applied only during the Grid & Start window.

**Edge cases**:

- Partial throttle and brake.
- Zero acceleration.
- Already-stopped vehicle.
- Brake plus throttle.
- Inactive simulation.
- Multiple render frames per simulation tick.
- 505 kg vehicle mass.
- Multiplier absent or outside its active window.

**Estimated test count**: ~11 tests.

### 4-4 vp-dynamics 004 — Steering Model

**Type**: Logic + Integration
**Test file paths**:

- `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`
- `Assets/tests/integration/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`

**Formula source**: `maxYaw = min(steerCeiling(v), v / minTurnRadius, gripCeiling)`.

**What to test**:

- Each of the three max-yaw terms can be the limiting term.
- Zero-speed behavior is limited by `v / minTurnRadius`.
- Canonical falloff returns 100% at 70% of vmax.
- Canonical falloff returns approximately 75% at 90% of vmax.
- The 65–75% transition band is smooth.
- New `steerOut` affects yaw within one physics step.
- No additional VP smoothing is applied.
- Reverse steering uses arcade sign inversion.
- Tuning configuration is consumed rather than hardcoded.

**Edge cases**:

- Zero speed.
- Zero steer.
- Exactly 65%, 70%, 75%, and 90% of vmax.
- Sign reversal.
- Zero-to-full steer.
- Configuration range limits.

**Estimated test count**: ~9 tests.

---

### 4-5 vp-dynamics 005 — Wall Contact & Car-to-Car

**Type**: Integration + Logic
**Test file paths**:

- `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`
- `Assets/tests/integration/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`

**Formula source**: `speed_after = speed_before × (1 − loss)`; car-to-car speed loss is 15–25%; wall bounce angle is at most 30°.

**What to test**:

- Injected wall-loss factor is applied before bounce impulse.
- Normal 0.40 loss and Very Hard 0.60 loss produce the specified retained speeds.
- Perpendicular impacts bounce at no more than 30° and continue moving.
- WallHit cooldown is deterministic and within 0.2–0.5 seconds.
- Repeated bounce impulse is reduced by 50%.
- Parallel scraping applies frictional loss without bounce.
- Steering is immediately responsive after cooldown.
- Combined car speed above 100 km/h causes both cars to lose the configured bounded percentage and receive opposing push impulses.
- Repeated car contact is suppressed during cooldown.
- A stopped car is pushed aside.
- `CarCollisionMonitor` forwards raw contact data only.
- State mutation occurs at the designated simulation step, not in callbacks.
- Near-zero wall impact produces no penalty or bounce.

**Edge cases**:

- Zero-speed wall contact.
- Epsilon incoming velocity.
- Cooldown boundary.
- Near-parallel contact.
- Enter/Stay/Exit callbacks.
- Null opposing collider.
- Both cars stopped.

**Estimated test count**: ~13 tests.

### 4-6 vp-feel 001 — Lift-Off Rotation & Tuck-In

**Type**: Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`

**Formula source**: `liftOffGripBonus = 3.0g = 29.43 m/s²`.

**What to test**:

- Throttle at zero with steering active emits exactly `29.43 m/s²` to both yaw and velocity-rotation consumers.
- Throttle above zero emits no lift-off bonus.
- Anti-spam requires 18 continuously held throttle ticks at 60 Hz.
- 17 ticks do not activate.
- Exactly 18 ticks activate.
- Runtime output assertions use fixed speed, steer, grip, and `FIXED_DT` fixtures.

**Edge cases**:

- Throttle exactly zero.
- Nonzero brake.
- Zero speed.
- Epsilon throttle above zero.
- Repeated taps.
- Zero-length hold.
- State reset during hold.

**Estimated test count**: ~7 tests.

### 4-7 vp-feel 002 — Drift Factor

**Type**: Logic + Integration
**Test file paths**:

- `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`
- `Assets/tests/integration/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`

**Formula source**: `vLimit = sqrt(aMax × R_ahead)`; transition uses `InverseLerp(vLimit, vLimit × 1.12)`; drift factor defaults to `1.15`; heading boost defaults to `1.40`; lookahead is `40m`.

**What to test**:

- Fake provider receives the current position and exactly 40m lookahead.
- `F = 1.0` at and below the threshold.
- Transition-band interpolation is correct.
- `F = 1.15` above the band while throttle is positive.
- Lift-off returns `F = 1.0` immediately.
- Heading factor is `F × 1.40` only while drifting.
- Velocity factor is always `F`.
- Heading boost is absent below the drift threshold.
- Defaults are read-only after race initialization.
- Invalid radii use deterministic no-drift fallback.

**Edge cases**:

- Straight-section large-radius sentinel.
- Zero radius.
- Negative radius.
- NaN and infinity.
- Exact threshold and band boundaries.
- Provider invocation count.

**Estimated test count**: ~11 tests.

### 4-8 vp-feel 003 — Real Engine Longitudinal

**Type**: Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/VehiclePhysicsTests.cs`

**Formula source**: `accel = min(enginePower, P/m ÷ v) − K·v²`, with `K = (P/m) ÷ vmax³`.

**What to test**:

- Numeric formula fixtures across low, mid, and high speed.
- Standstill uses `enginePower` without division by zero.
- Traction cap is approximately `13.5 m/s²` below approximately 90 km/h.
- Quadratic mode emits `LinearDamping = 0`.
- Motor force is parallel to heading rather than velocity.
- Equilibrium approaches vmax asymptotically; practical top speed approximation remains theoretical minus 2 km/h.

**Edge cases**:

- Exactly zero speed.
- Sub-floor speed.
- Reverse velocity.
- Negative or invalid numeric inputs.
- Exactly 90 km/h.
- Zero or mismatched heading.
- Reversing direction.

**Estimated test count**: ~7 tests.

### 4-11 track 001 — Track JSON Schema & Addressable Loading

**Type**: Integration + Logic
**Test file paths**:

- `Assets/tests/unit/content/TrackDataTests.cs`
- `Assets/tests/integration/content/TrackDataTests.cs`

**Formula source**: No story-specific GDD formula found. Track position and surface formulas are not the primary requirements for this loader story.

**What to test**:

- v1 `TrackDataContainer` with camelCase fields loads populated `TrackData`.
- `schemaVersion == 1`.
- Required fields are not defaulted.
- Exact Addressables key `Tracks/{trackId}` is used.
- Addressable handle releases after successful validation.
- Handle releases after corrupt JSON and validation failure.
- Corrupt JSON, unsupported schema, and missing required fields produce `ContentLoadError(Track)`.
- Errors include track ID and failing field/category.
- No partial track is returned.
- Local game-space float3 coordinates are preserved.
- Longitude/latitude source fields are rejected.
- Monaco, Monza, Silverstone, and Spa all use the same contract.
- Parse and validation remain below 50 ms per track, excluding Addressables I/O.

**Edge cases**:

- Bare top-level array.
- Snake_case payload.
- Null data.
- Empty required arrays.
- Corrupt JSON.
- Schema mismatch.
- Missing field.
- Release after every failure path.

**Estimated test count**: ~14 tests.

> **Schema naming risk**: Story/ADR acceptance requires camelCase, while the control manifest's global naming table still states snake_case for Track JSON. The test fixture must follow the current story/ADR contract; this inconsistency should be resolved before implementation is marked complete.

### 4-12 track 002 — Runtime Spline Materialization & Surface

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/content/TrackDataTests.cs`

**Formula source**: Track GDD position and surface formulas; approved surface table is specified in the story.

  - Runoff: grip 0.6, wear 2.5
  - PitLane: grip 1.0, wear 1.0
- Elevation and bank angle survive runtime materialization.
- `metadata.elevationRangeMeters` is validated.

**Edge cases**:

- Progress exactly at zone boundaries.
- Progress wrapping.
- Out-of-range progress.
- Default asphalt gaps.
- First and last surface zone.
- PitLane lookup.

**Estimated test count**: ~8 tests.

### 4-14 track 004 — Lap Boundary Provider

**Type**: Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/content/TrackDataTests.cs`

**Formula source**: No matching GDD Formula section formula was found for the provider's accumulator. Use the story/ADR rule directly: `max(0, mapped_progress_delta × trackLength)` with one wrap adjustment.

**What to test**:

- `CrossedLapBoundary(0.94, 0.01)` returns true.
- Non-wrap movement returns false.
- Reverse movement returns false.
- Forward-distance accumulator increases only from forward progress.
- One wrap adjustment is applied.
- Reverse and lateral movement do not increase the accumulator.
- Pit-lane crossings use racing-spline mapping for wrap detection.

**Edge cases**:

- Exactly one track-length traversal.
- Progress at zero and one.
- Multiple wraps in one input.
- Reverse across the boundary.
- Pit-lane mapped progress.

**Estimated test count**: ~5 tests.

### 4-16 track 006 — Trackside Placement Manifest & Validation

**Type**: Logic + Integration
**Test file paths**:

- `Assets/tests/unit/content/TracksidePlacementTests.cs`
- `Assets/tests/integration/content/TrackDataTests.cs`

**Formula source**: No GDD formula found for placement manifests. Validate the transform-complete contract from the story.

**What to test**:

- Full position, rotation, and scale values deserialize exactly.
- Same asset ID can appear at multiple independent transforms.
- Duplicate exact transform for the same asset ID is rejected.
- Unknown asset ID produces `ContentLoadError(Track)`.
- Non-finite position or rotation is rejected.
- Scale less than or equal to zero is rejected.
- No partial manifest is returned after validation failure.
- Missing or empty manifest loads successfully with zero trackside entries.
- Serialize → deserialize is byte-stable.
- Authoring hints do not alter resolved placement.

**Edge cases**:

- Negative coordinates.
- Arbitrary rotation, including y = 12.5.

### 4-19 car-def 001 — CarDefinition Data Model & Stat Formulas

**Type**: Logic, with Config/Data coverage
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/car/CarDefinitionFormulaTests.cs`

**Formula source**:

- `max_velocity = 300 + stat × 2.0`
- `brake_distance = min + ((20 − stat) / 20) × (max − min)`
- Grip percentage from 50% to 90% of the car's own vmax.
- `control_threshold = stat / 20`, with resolved low-stat behavior.
- `efficiency_modifier = 1 − stat × 0.025`.

**What to test**:

- Strict TeamId parsing for `team_tier{1-4}_{a-d}`.
- Read-only accessors for TeamId, Tier, Stats, AudioProfile, TeamColor, and CockpitOffset.
- Exactly six integer stats.
- Global weight resolves to 505 kg.
- Top Speed 4 → 308 ±0.1 km/h.
- Top Speed 20 → 340 km/h.
- Brake 4 → 70 ±0.1m.
- Brake 20 → 30m.
- Grip 4 → 58% of supplied vmax.
- Grip 20 → 90%.
- Stability 4 → 0.2 ±0.001.
- Stability 20 → 1.0.
- Efficiency 4 → 0.90 ±0.001.
- Efficiency 20 → 0.50 ±0.001.
- Formula output is difficulty-invariant.
- Stats 0 and 20 follow the resolved boundary design.

**Edge cases**:

- Null, empty, malformed, wrong-case, and extra-character TeamIds.
- Stats at 0 and 20.
- Attempted public mutation.
- Difficulty profile changes.
- Per-car vmax for grip percentage.

**Estimated test count**: ~10 parameterized test groups.

> The GDD's t300 metric is explicitly Vehicle Physics-owned and is not tested here.

### 4-23 race-strategy 001 — Fuel System

**Type**: Logic + Integration
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/FuelSystemTests.cs`

**Formula source**:

- `fuel_rate = 0.06 × throttle × efficiency_modifier`
- Efficiency modifier: `1 − stat × 0.025`
- Pit refill: `0.8 L/s`
- Low-fuel bonus per current story/ADR: `1.01` when fuel fraction is below 25%.

**What to test**:

- Efficiency is consumed once at race initialization.
- Fuel rate at Eff4 and full throttle is `0.054 L/s`.
- Fuel is clamped to 0–8L.
- Countdown and non-Racing ticks do not change fuel.
- Pit service refills toward target at 0.8L/s.
- Fuel does not drain during active service.
- LapCompleted updates `lastLapFuelUse` once and clamps it non-negative.
- Threshold transitions occur at the specified boundaries.
- Exactly 50% and exactly 25% retain the prior state.
- Zero fuel produces Empty.
- Low-fuel modifier is 1.01 below 25% and 1.00 at 25%.
- Identical input sequence produces identical FuelState.
- Depletion fixtures match approximately 148.148s, 266.667s, and the specified 50% throttle survival fixture.

**Edge cases**:

- Zero throttle.
- Clamped throttle.
- Zero delta time.
- Near-empty fuel.
- Countdown, Loading, Paused, and Finished.
- Target already reached.
- Duplicate LapCompleted.
- Pit refill apparent fuel increase.

**Estimated test count**: ~10 tests.

> The GDD retains an older linear low-fuel example of 0.6% at 10% fuel. The story and ADR explicitly supersede it with a 1.01 multiplier below 25%; automated tests must use the current story contract.

### 4-24 race-strategy 002 — Tire System

**Type**: Logic + Integration
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/TireSystemTests.cs`

**Formula source**:

- `tire_wear_rate = base_rate × distance_factor × aggression × surface_penalty × efficiency_modifier × wearRateMultiplier`
- `distance_factor = clamp(speedKmh / 300, 0, 1)`
- Runtime grip is linear from 1.0 at 0% wear to 0.20 at 100%.

**What to test**:

- Wear 0%, 50%, and 100% produce grip 1.00, 0.60 ±0.01, and 0.20 ±0.01.
- Wear clamps to 0–1.
- Off-track surface multiplier produces approximately 2.5× wear.
- Aggression 2.0 produces approximately 2× wear.
- Efficiency 20 and 4 produce approximately 50% and 90% base-rate behavior.
- Countdown and qualifying produce no wear.
- First Racing tick begins wear.
- Active pit service accumulates no wear.
- Exactly 2.0 seconds of continuous eligible service resets wear.
- A 1.9-second interruption does not complete the swap.
- LapCompleted updates `lastLapTireWear` once.
- Immutable compound data is consumed without direct ScriptableObject dependency.

**Edge cases**:

- Wear below 0 and above 1.
- Zero speed.
- Speed above 300 km/h.
- Qualifying input attempting to bypass gating.
- Pit service interruption.
- Duplicate LapCompleted.
- Zero wear.

**Estimated test count**: ~8 tests.

- Fuel and Tire state mutation remains owned by their systems.

**Edge cases**:

- Exactly 2.0 seconds.
- Target fuel below current fuel.
- Repeated Confirm.
- Partial fuel.
- Inactive command.

### 4-27 race-strategy 005 — Pit Advisory & Lifecycle

**Type**: Integration + Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/integration/simulation/PitStopTests.cs` and companion unit coverage in `Assets/tests/unit/simulation/PitStopTests.cs`

**Formula source**:

- `predictedFuel = currentFuel − lastLapFuelUse × remainingProgress`
- `predictedTire = (1 − currentWearFraction) − lastLapTireWear × remainingProgress`
- `pitThisLap = not lap1 and not finalLap and (predictedFuel < 1.10 × neededFuel OR predictedTire < 1.10 × neededTire)`
- `warning_start = min(0.80, max(0, pitEntryProgress − 0.05))`

**What to test**:

- Fuel-only failure triggers advisory.
- Tire-only failure triggers advisory.
- Strict equality at the 1.10 threshold does not trigger.
- Entry progress 0.72 produces warning start 0.67.
- Entry progress above 0.85 caps warning start at 0.80.
- Negative entry progress floors warning start at 0.
- Advisory is suppressed on lap 1.
- Advisory is suppressed on the final lap.
- Advisory is suppressed while PitTransit, InPitBox, or Exiting.
- Pit-entry clears the advisory exactly once.
- Duplicate entry is a no-op.
- Exit restores normal evaluation.
- Output is immutable for HUD and AI consumers.
- RSM events are consumed through the event seam.

**Edge cases**:

- One resource sufficient while the other fails.
- Exact equality.
- Duplicate entry event.
- Exit before and after a cleared advisory.
- Zero last-lap fuel use.
- Zero last-lap tire wear.
- Boundary progress values.

**Estimated test count**: ~11 tests.

## Manual QA Checklist

### 4-10 vp-feel 005 — Dev Playtest Rig

**Verification method**: Game View playthrough plus screenshot and written feel evidence.
**Who must sign off**: QA Lead and gameplay/vehicle-physics lead; designer review is recommended for feel observations.
**Evidence**:

- `production/qa/evidence/vehicle-physics-feel-rig-evidence.md`
- Game View screenshot
- Recorded benchmark values
- Written observations for lift-off, drift, and launch

Checklist:

- [ ] The saved development scene opens successfully.
- [ ] The scene contains the kernel, vehicle driver, input path, one real track fixture, one real car fixture, and development camera adapter.
- [ ] Input reaches the kernel during play.
- [ ] The car moves on the loaded track.
- [ ] Telemetry updates while the car is moving.
- [ ] The camera renders a playable Game View.
- [ ] Zero-input behavior does not cause unintended movement.
- [ ] Reloading the scene preserves a usable rig.
- [ ] Missing optional presentation consumers do not prevent the core rig path from running.
- [ ] The camera adapter can be replaced without rig-coupled camera logic.
- [ ] Lift-off rotation at 70% speed after at least 0.3 seconds of throttle hold is recorded as approximately 5–10 degrees.
- [ ] Low-speed lift-off rotation at 20% speed is recorded as less than 2 degrees.
- [ ] Drift is visibly distinguishable during an above-limit accelerating corner.
- [ ] Longitudinal benchmark evidence records the 0→vmax timing.
- [ ] CP1/CP2 top-speed benchmark evidence is recorded against the loaded car stat formula.
- [ ] The evidence identifies the track fixture, car fixture, engine version, and test date.
- [ ] Screenshot and notes are reviewed and signed before story completion.

The playtest is advisory for Sprint 4 and is not a release blocker unless the team elects to make the feel gate blocking.

## Smoke Test Scope

Run `/smoke-check sprint` before manual QA hand-off.

1. **Compilation and test assembly health**
   - Project compiles under Unity 6000.3.22f1.
   - Existing system assemblies remain loadable.
   - New tests join the matching system assemblies rather than a bare `tests/` root.

2. **Simulation kernel path**
   - Development rig or existing game entry point launches without a crash.
   - A new session can be initialized.
   - The canonical 14-step tick runs in order.
   - Step 6 applies forces before the single `Physics.Simulate`.
   - CarState readout occurs after simulation.
   - Countdown remains 300 ticks and GridLocked behavior is preserved.
   - No prohibited `FixedUpdate`, `Time.fixedDeltaTime`, or `Time.deltaTime` usage exists in VehiclePhysicsSystem.

3. **Vehicle physics regression**
   - Grip floor and ceiling are respected.
   - Steering, acceleration, braking, coasting, wall contact, and car-to-car contact execute without exceptions.
   - Rigidbody uses Unity 6.3 APIs: `linearVelocity`, `linearDamping`, and `angularDamping`.
   - No WheelCollider or DOTS/ECS implementation is introduced.
   - Collision callbacks only forward raw contact data.

4. **Content pipeline regression**
   - Addressables content loads through addresses, not group names.
   - Track uses `Tracks/{trackId}`.
   - Car definitions use `Cars/{teamId}/CarDefinition`.
   - Handles release on successful and failed loading paths.
   - Missing/corrupt track content fails descriptively without returning partial data.
   - Car degradation and diagnostics follow the existing content policy.

5. **Track loading and materialization**
   - Monaco, Monza, Silverstone, and Spa load through the same TrackData contract.
   - Track spline materializes into a usable racing surface.
   - Closed-loop sampling is valid.
   - Surface table values are available.
   - Pit geometry, grid slots, and lap-boundary provider fixtures load.
   - Trackside assembly instantiates deterministically.
   - Track A → Track B reconfiguration releases Track A instances and handles.

6. **Car-definition content**
   - All 16 car addresses resolve.
   - Team IDs match addresses.
   - Six stats are present and within [0,20].
   - Weight resolves to 505 kg.
   - Shared validation configuration loads.
   - Duplicate-stat diagnostics are produced where applicable.

7. **Fuel and tire kernel paths**
   - Fuel and Tire execute before physics.
   - Countdown and Qualifying do not consume fuel or tire wear.
   - Fuel and tire remain independent of CarState mutation.
   - Grip and wear floors remain valid.

8. **Pit-stop path**
   - PitServiceCommand is emitted at the correct lifecycle phase.
   - Refuel rate is 0.8 L/s.
   - Tire swap completes after exactly 2 seconds of continuous eligible service.
   - Player and AI exit policies remain distinct.
   - Sixteen-car pit assignments are isolated.
   - Advisory suppression and clearing work at lifecycle boundaries.

9. **Determinism and forbidden-pattern regression**
   - Identical fixtures and input sequences produce identical outputs.
   - No stateful RNG is introduced on these simulation paths.
   - No system writes another system's owned state.
   - Fuel and Tire do not write CarState.
   - Presentation consumers use published snapshots rather than live simulation state.

10. **Performance guardrails**
    - Simulation tick p95 is at most 6 ms and maximum is at most 8 ms for the representative 16-car fixture.
    - Fuel and Tire combined execution remains at or below 0.2 ms.
    - Pit Stop remains approximately 0.05 ms.
    - Track parse and validation remain below 50 ms per track, excluding Addressables I/O.
    - First-load and track-load ceilings remain within the project budgets where the representative content fixture is available.

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when all of the following are true:

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is verified by passing automated tests or documented manual evidence.
- [ ] Every Logic story has the required unit test file under `Assets/tests/unit/<system>/`.
- [ ] Every Integration story has the required integration test file under `Assets/tests/integration/<system>/` or approved documented integration evidence.
- [ ] Mixed stories include both unit and integration coverage where specified.
- [ ] Story 4-10 has Game View screenshot, feel observations, benchmark values, and sign-off.
- [ ] Test assemblies compile and pass under Unity 6000.3.22f1.
- [ ] `/smoke-check sprint` passes before QA hand-off.
- [ ] No regressions are introduced in the 60 Hz simulation pipeline, Addressables content loading, track mounting, or 16-car state isolation.
- [ ] Forbidden-pattern guards pass:
  - [ ] No `FixedUpdate`, `Time.fixedDeltaTime`, or `Time.deltaTime` in VehiclePhysicsSystem.
  - [ ] No obsolete Rigidbody APIs.
  - [ ] No WheelCollider or DOTS/ECS MVP implementation.
  - [ ] No stateful RNG on the simulation path.
  - [ ] Fuel and Tire do not mutate CarState.
  - [ ] Trackside content does not define racing surface semantics.
- [ ] Code review is completed through `/code-review` or documented peer review.
- [ ] Story file is updated to `Status: Complete` through `/story-done`.
- [ ] The car-definition tier-average acceptance-band ambiguity is resolved before 4-22 is marked complete.
- [ ] The Track JSON camelCase versus control-manifest snake_case discrepancy is resolved or explicitly ratified before 4-11 is marked complete.
